stage: RACE Stage 2: Adaptive Multi-Horizon Future-Reuse Ranking
objective: Test whether an online causal algorithm that combines multiple imperfect future-reuse advisers and adapts their weights under delayed feedback recovers substantially more of the frozen Stage 0 offline-oracle advantage than the frozen Stage 1 winner, using the unchanged Stage 1 eviction mechanism.

stage1_reference.diagnostic_finding: Perfect next-use scoring with the same trivial eviction mechanism exactly reproduces the offline oracle, so future-reuse ranking rather than combinatorial eviction is the remaining bottleneck.

inherited_cache_semantics.cache_namespaces: one independent cache per MoE layer
inherited_cache_semantics.expert_identity: (layer_id, expert_id); expert_id values are local to a layer
inherited_cache_semantics.request_semantics: all eight experts in a layer event inspect the same pre-event resident set
inherited_cache_semantics.admission: all current-request misses are mandatory admissions
inherited_cache_semantics.post_event_state: complete current atomic request union selected experts retained from the pre-event resident set
inherited_cache_semantics.initial_state: empty at the start of each frozen workload path

capacity_8_role: degenerate sanity check only; never enters any Stage 2 verdict count

MARKOV_Hh.implementation: frozen Stage 1 MarkovPredictor: mean row of a calibration-fitted binary transition matrix over the current atomic request
MARKOV_Hh.fit_data: the frozen Stage 0 calibration workload path only
MARKOV_Hh.stage1_reuse_requirement: horizons 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 must be bitwise identical to the frozen Stage 1 transition model; horizon 32 is newly fitted on the identical calibration path with the identical frozen fitting function

PERSISTENCE.implementation: frozen Stage 1 PersistencePredictor: unit score for the previous same-layer request

extended_pool_ablation.name: extended
extended_pool_ablation.added_adviser_definition: the frozen Stage 1 winner itself: 0.5 * Markov-H2 probability + 0.5 * request-indicator EWMA with alpha 0.95
extended_pool_ablation.role: clearly labeled adviser-diversity ablation only; never enters the Stage 2 verdict
extended_pool_ablation.motivation: The frozen Stage 1 winner is a raw-scale blend of two pool members. Percentile-normalized combination of those two members cannot reproduce it, so the primary pool cannot express the comparison baseline. The extended pool answers the preregistered diagnostic question 'is adviser diversity too low?' without changing the primary result.

adviser_score_timing.markov: score the current atomic request against the immutable calibration-fitted matrix before the retention decision
adviser_score_timing.gate_ewma: g <- alpha*g then g[e] += (1-alpha)*w_e for the current request, before the retention decision
adviser_score_timing.lfu_decay: f <- alpha*f then f[e] += 1 for the current request, before the retention decision
adviser_score_timing.persistence: score with the previous same-layer request, then store the current request
adviser_score_timing.orientation: every adviser is oriented so that a larger raw score means retain more strongly

rank_normalization.scope: the eligible eviction-candidate set at the current decision event, i.e. pre-event residents that are not in the current atomic request
rank_normalization.formula: z = midrank(score among candidates, ascending, ties averaged) / max(n-1, 1)
rank_normalization.orientation: 1.0 = adviser most strongly recommends retaining; 0.0 = adviser most strongly recommends evicting
rank_normalization.tie_handling: exact adviser-score ties receive identical midranks, which is a deterministic function of the candidate score multiset
rank_normalization.degenerate_case: n <= 1 yields z = 0 for the single candidate; the retention decision is then unaffected

combined_score_and_eviction.score: S_e = sum_j w_j * z_{j,e} with w on the probability simplex
combined_score_and_eviction.eviction_rule: retain the capacity-minus-request-size highest-S eligible candidates; evict the remainder
combined_score_and_eviction.deterministic_tie_breaking: S descending, then LRU recency descending, then expert ID ascending (the exact frozen Stage 1 ranking after the score)

bounded_future_reuse_target.definition: d_tilde(q, e) = min(number of same-layer events after q until e is next requested, H_max + 1)
bounded_future_reuse_target.encoding: 1 = requested at the next same-layer event; 33 = not requested within the next 32 same-layer events
bounded_future_reuse_target.causal_property: fully known once 32 further same-layer events have been observed

delayed_feedback_protocol.learning_example_rule: one pending example per (capacity, layer) at every same-layer event whose retention decision actually required at least one eviction while at least one retention slot remained, i.e. 0 < capacity - request_size < candidate_count; these are exactly the events at which the RACE ranking can change the outcome
delayed_feedback_protocol.resolution_point: at same-layer event index q + 32, immediately after that event's atomic request has been observed and before that event's own retention decision
delayed_feedback_protocol.update_point: identical to the resolution point; weight_update_index == label_resolution_index == q + 32
delayed_feedback_protocol.audit_requirement: weight_update_index >= label_resolution_index >= q + H_max for every applied update
delayed_feedback_protocol.multiple_simultaneous_examples: at most one example per (capacity, layer) resolves at any same-layer event, so chronological order is exact and unambiguous
delayed_feedback_protocol.end_of_stream_rule: decisions inside the final 32 same-layer events of a stream produce no weight update; their costs still count and their unresolved count and fraction are recorded

losses.comparable_pairs: ordered candidate pairs (a, b) with d_tilde(a) < d_tilde(b)
losses.adviser_inversion_indicator: I_j(a,b) = 0 when adviser j ranks a strictly above b, 1 when it ranks b strictly above a, 0.5 on an exact adviser-score tie
losses.rank_loss: L_rank(q, j) = sum over comparable pairs of I_j(a,b) divided by the number of comparable ordered pairs
losses.cost_loss: L_cost(q, j) = sum over comparable pairs of omega(a,b) * I_j(a,b) divided by sum over comparable pairs of omega(a,b), with omega(a,b) = |1/d_tilde(a) - 1/d_tilde(b)| and phi(d) = 1/d fixed
losses.empty_comparable_set: skip the learning example entirely; no weight update is applied and the skip is counted
losses.zero_denominator_guard: cost-sensitive denominators are checked for positivity before division; a non-positive denominator skips the example

RACE_STATIC.weights: one shared global calibration-learned weight vector, never updated during evaluation

RACE_ONLINE.weights: delayed Hedge multiplicative weights on the unweighted pairwise rank loss

RACE_COST.weights: delayed Hedge multiplicative weights on the cost-sensitive pairwise loss

static_weight_learning.data: resolved learning examples produced by RACE_UNIFORM on the frozen Stage 0 calibration workload path at the four decision capacities
static_weight_learning.subsample_rule: keep every 64th resolved calibration example per (capacity, layer) stream in chronological order
static_weight_learning.objective: mean over kept examples of the pair-count-normalized logistic pairwise ranking loss of the combined score, log(1 + exp(-(S_a - S_b)/tau)) over comparable pairs
static_weight_learning.tau_status: fixed structural constant; not selected on any outcome
static_weight_learning.optimizer: projected gradient descent onto the probability simplex; each iteration starts from twice the last accepted step and halves it until the Armijo sufficient-decrease condition holds, and the run stops when no admissible projected-gradient step remains, which for this convex objective is the first-order optimality condition
static_weight_learning.selection: the iterate with the lowest objective value; ties resolved by the earliest iterate
static_weight_learning.scope: one shared global weight vector is the primary static baseline; a per-layer static weight vector is a clearly labeled ablation
reported: objective at the learned weights and at uniform weights
zero-one pairwise ranking loss at the learned weights and at uniform weights
iterations run, backtracks used and stopping reason

online_learning.update: w_j <- w_j * exp(-eta * loss_j), then renormalized to the simplex
online_learning.implementation: maintained in natural logarithm space with per-step maximum subtraction; exactly equivalent to the stated multiplicative update
online_learning.eta_scope: one single global Stage 2 learning rate; never per capacity, per domain, per workload type or per evaluation stream
online_learning.weight_scope_primary: one weight vector per (cache capacity, MoE layer) policy instance
online_learning.weight_scope_ablation: one weight vector per cache capacity shared across all layers
online_learning.capacity_state_isolation: policy instances for different cache capacities never share live online state
online_learning.reset_rule: adviser weights, adviser state, pending-example queues and rolling label windows are all reset exactly where the frozen evaluation protocol resets the cache, i.e. at the start of each frozen workload path; they persist and adapt causally within a workload path
online_learning.regret_accounting_weights: the empirical mixture loss uses the weight vector that was actually deployed at the decision event, which is carried with the pending example, not the weight vector at resolution time

calibration_plan.data: the frozen Stage 0 calibration workload path only (80 sequences, disjoint from every evaluation workload)
calibration_plan.selection_cost: unit misses summed across capacities 12, 16, 24 and 32 on that calibration path
steps: fit Stage 2 transition models including horizon 32 and verify horizons 1-16 against the frozen Stage 1 model
run RACE_UNIFORM on calibration and collect subsampled learning examples
learn the global RACE_STATIC weight vector from those examples
run the 6 RACE_ONLINE configurations over eta in {0.1, 0.3, 1.0} crossed with initialization in {uniform, static} and select one (eta, initialization) pair
run RACE_COST with the selected (eta, initialization) pair
select the primary RACE variant between RACE_ONLINE and RACE_COST
calibration_plan.eta_and_initialization_selection: the (eta, initialization) pair minimizing RACE_ONLINE calibration selection cost
calibration_plan.primary_variant_selection: the lower calibration selection cost between RACE_ONLINE and RACE_COST
calibration_plan.primary_variant_tie_break: RACE_ONLINE, because the unweighted rank loss is the simpler mechanism
calibration_plan.extended_pool_steps: the extended pool repeats the RACE_UNIFORM collection and static-weight learning on calibration and then reuses the single global (eta, initialization) selected on the primary pool; no separate learning rate is selected for it
calibration_plan.static_example_source_policy: RACE_UNIFORM of the same adviser pool

pilot.purpose: correctness, causal audit, delayed-label validation, runtime, weight stability and numerical stability only
pilot.data: the first 8 sequences of the frozen Stage 0 calibration workload path; no evaluation sequence is touched

evaluation_protocol.workloads: exactly the ten frozen Stage 0 evaluation workload records and orderings used by Stage 1
evaluation_protocol.runs: one single frozen evaluation after the Stage 2 configuration is sealed
evaluation_protocol.reference_costs: the frozen Stage 1 winner rows, the frozen Stage 0 strongest-simple rows and the frozen Stage 0 oracle rows are read from the sealed archives and are never recomputed

metrics.denominator_rule: the oracle-gap denominator always uses the original Stage 0 strongest-simple cost and is never redefined relative to Stage 1
metrics.zero_denominator_handling: null / N/A when the denominator is zero; capacity 8 never enters a verdict

condition_a.paired_uncertainty_requirement: the paired bootstrap 95% interval for the improvement must exclude zero from below at each counted capacity

very_strong_success.note: this label never modifies the STRONG_SUCCESS rule

weak.rule: a consistent improvement over Stage 1 of at least 0.05 at 3 or more of the four non-degenerate capacities that nonetheless misses the STRONG_SUCCESS rule

no_go.rule: improvement over Stage 1 below 0.05 at 2 or more of the four non-degenerate capacities, or any non-degenerate capacity with C_RACE > 1.03 * C_Stage1, or the primary online variant failing to beat both RACE_STATIC and RACE_UNIFORM on the frozen suite aggregate at 3 or more non-degenerate capacities

success_criteria.precedence: NO_GO if the NO_GO rule holds; otherwise VERY_STRONG_SUCCESS if its rule holds; otherwise STRONG_SUCCESS if its rule holds; otherwise WEAK if its rule holds; otherwise NO_GO
success_criteria.primary_basis: frozen ten-workload-suite aggregate unit-miss cost at each non-degenerate capacity for the frozen primary RACE variant

regression_criterion.reporting: every flagged regression is reported even when the aggregate result is positive; capacities are never cherry-picked

ranking_quality: pairwise ordering accuracy P(S_a > S_b | d_tilde_a < d_tilde_b) with 0.5 credit for exact score ties, on the actual eviction candidate sets
the same quantity under the true uncapped next-use distance
oracle-consistent eviction rate: at least one evicted expert attains the maximum true next-use distance among the candidates
oracle-optimal eviction rate: the evicted multiset of true next-use distances equals the largest such multiset available
delayed_feedback: examples unresolved at stream end and their fraction
examples skipped for having no comparable pair
average and maximum feedback delay in same-layer events
diagnostics.horizon_analysis: mean weight assigned to MARKOV_H1, H2, H4, H8, H16 and H32 at each capacity, tested against spare residency slots B - 8
diagnostics.regret_accounting: cumulative resolved mixture loss of RACE minus the minimum cumulative loss of any single fixed adviser; explicitly empirical, never presented as a theoretical guarantee
diagnostics.figure3_layer_selection_rule: the layer with the median and the layer with the largest per-layer miss reduction of the frozen primary RACE variant relative to RACE_UNIFORM on the mixed_interleaved workload at capacity 32; ties are broken by the smaller layer index and no layer is ever chosen by inspecting a figure
diagnostics.observer_design: an offline one-way sink holding the complete frozen-path future; the simulator pushes copies of decisions it has already made and the observer returns nothing that can re-enter policy state
diagnostics.diagnostic_subsampling: none; every eviction decision is measured

required_audits.causality_test: record decision_event_index, label_resolution_event_index and weight_update_event_index for sampled updates and require update >= resolution >= decision + 32 in same-layer coordinates; any violation is a Stage 2 failure
required_audits.perfect_score_check: the Stage 2 eviction mechanism driven by exact next-use scores must reproduce the frozen Stage 0 oracle cost, and the frozen Stage 1 perfect_score_simple_policy rows must still equal the Stage 0 oracle rows on all previously validated conditions
required_audits.observer_non_interference: enabling the offline diagnostic observer must leave every simulated cost bit-identical
required_audits.future_mutation_test: mutating future trace content must not change any causal Stage 2 action
required_audits.stage0_stage1_regression: the complete Stage 0 and Stage 1 test suites must continue to pass unchanged
required_audits.stage1_single_predictor_equivalence: a Stage 2 variant that places all adviser weight on one pool member must reproduce the corresponding frozen Stage 1 single-predictor cost exactly, because midrank normalization is a tie-preserving monotone transform and the tie-break is unchanged

statistics.paired_unit: source decode sequence, stratified by domain
statistics.primary_suite_aggregation: At each capacity, sum raw unit-miss costs across all ten frozen workload paths; no per-capacity, per-regime or per-workload variant reselection.
statistics.regime_results: also report stationary, abrupt, repeated and mixed aggregates separately
statistics.conditionality: Intervals reweight saved per-sequence contributions conditional on each frozen stateful workload path; stateful cache and online-learning trajectories are not regenerated under reordered bootstrap workloads.
